Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 1230 PM EST Wed Nov 25 2026
 

- Dry and seasonable conditions today.

- Widespread rain develops Thanksgiving afternoon and continues into 
Friday.  

- Another round of rain likely to end the weekend.

&&

.AVIATION...

MVFR stratus continues to creep westward across the area while 
gradually lifting/scattering toward lower VFR early this afternoon. 
A ridge of high pressure stalls over the northern Great Lakes while 
a surface trough extends into the Ohio Valley from low pressure 
developing over Florida. This sustains moderate east to northeast 
wind across the area through tonight and into Thursday morning. 
Initially dry mid- and low-levels favor predominant VFR conditions 
tonight as high cloud begins to arrive from the Ohio Valley trough. 
The easterly wind is expected to bring another round of low cloud 
downwind of Lake Erie Thursday morning - potential exists for a 
period of MVFR ceilings. Strengthening northeast winds and 
deteriorating aviation conditions then ensue daytime Thursday as the 
rain shield associated with broad low pressure arrives from the 
south. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* Medium for ceiling at or below 5000 feet after 08z Thursday, then 
  high after 18z.
